scope_policy: Named places, watercourses, historical facilities, person inscriptions, printed spot heights, literal geological descriptions and historical notes. Excludes marginal legends/graticule/compass apparatus, unit codes, report references and bare dip/strike numerals. No modern facts or feature positions inferred.
